package.name: virtual_perception
package.description: Manages virtual objects (opponents + static obstacles) and injects them into the perception stack of a real OR simulated f1tenth car, for practice. Two independent man-in-the-middle seams: (1) a LiDAR overlay (base /scan_raw -> /scan, each vehicle sees every virtual object EXCEPT itself) and (2) a tracking merge (real /tracking/obstacles_raw + virtual -> /tracking/obstacles, ego excluded). Both are toggled from the Sim Control panel / launch. The base map scan is produced by the simulator (gym) or the real LiDAR; this package only overlays/merges, it does not raycast (that stays in `raycaster`).
